workload.retention: One 1000-row measured batch at a time; validate and hash after timing, then release before the next batch.

data.timing_scope: Row generation and retention only; excludes warm-up, validation, hashing, printing, and report writes.
data.worker_assertion_scope: Child process assertions only; not included in parent PHPUnit/JUnit assertion counts.
data.memory_metric: memory_get_peak_usage(true): PHP allocated process peak, not OS RSS or Faker-exclusive memory.
data.peak_capture_point: After all measured batches are validated, hashed, and released; before measurement serialization and report writes.

framework_scope.description: Composer autoloader plus PHPUnit assertion classes and their loaded dependencies; no PHPUnit runner is started.
framework_scope.memory_includes: PHP runtime allocations, Composer, Faker, PHPUnit assertion classes, and loaded dependencies.

provenance: New implementation and current execution; not historical teammate output
